questions.q: Goshen is the same place as which land?
questions.explain: Moses wrote the place under the name of his own day.

questions.q: What law did Joseph make over Egypt?
choices: Give a tenth to the priests
All land belongs to the people
Give the fifth part unto Pharaoh; four parts are your own
questions.explain: Pay the fifth part, and lay up for the years of trouble.

questions.q: How old was Jacob when he died?
choices: An hundred forty and seven years
questions.explain: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years.

questions.q: What did Jacob make Joseph swear?
choices: To bury him in the burying place of his fathers
To return to Canaan at once
questions.explain: By faith Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph (Hebrews 11:21).
